text:
alex: Quick RFC follow-up — we need a concrete rollout plan for the v1 -> v3 API migration. TL;DR: customers still hit v1, we can't break them, and shipping a full SDK migration in 2 weeks is unrealistic. proposing a compat-proxy that translates v1 requests to v3 and back. thoughts?

maria: +1 on a proxy. can we scope what the proxy must do vs what we ask customers to change? e.g., header names and streaming behavior are the big ones. :thinking_face:

sam: We should enumerate incompatibilities first. From notes: 1) streaming chunk format changed (now uses `event: token` vs raw chunks), 2) function call metadata moved in payload, 3) embeddings endpoint returns 2d vs 1d shape for older clients.

aj: (typo, meant jyoti) jyoti: agree with sam. Also plan for auth header fallback: some customers set `X-API-KEY` previously; new API expects `Authorization: Bearer`. proxy should accept both.

alex: Good catches. Here's a minimal list of proxy responsibilities: accept old auth header, translate v1 streaming frames to v1-compatible framing, map old param names (`max_tokens` -> `max_new_tokens`), rewrite function-call shapes, and proxy errors preserving v1 error codes. Everything else should be passthrough.

maria: Sounds reasonable. Tradeoffs: adds ~5-12ms p95 latency per request at current load if implemented in Go with pooled encoders. We should measure in staging. Also want feature flag to turn translation on/off per-customer.

sam: For the streaming translation: pseudo code we can use in proxy:```
// on v3 frame: {"type":"token","data":"hello"} -> v1 expects raw utf8 chunk
if frame.type == "token": write(frame.data)
if frame.type == "end": write("[DONE]")
```
This will handle most cases, but note we lose the structured `role` info unless we inject it in initial metadata chunk.

jyoti: Tests: need contract tests that assert equivalence of responses for a curated set of prompts (golden set). I'll add a job that hits both v1 and the proxy->v3 path and diffs normalized tokens and important metadata. QA-bot can run nightly.

qa-bot: Created nightly job: `compat-proxy-golden` (cron 02:30 UTC). Stores results in `s3://redwood-compat/goldens/`.

alex: Deployment plan: 1) implement proxy behind `compat.redwood.ai` route in staging, 2) run golden tests, smoke streaming, embedding shape tests, 3) enable per-customer feature flag (via LaunchDarkly), 4) small canary 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h with rollback window. Add dashboards for latency + error budget.

maria: For canary, we need circuit-breakers to fallback to v1 direct path if translation fails. Also add header `X-Compat-Proxy: sample` so logs show which path.

sam: Metric names proposal: `compat.proxy.latency.p95`, `compat.proxy.error_rate`, `compat.translation.mismatch_count` (when golden diff finds divergence).

jyoti: One tricky edge: streaming + function-calls. v3 sometimes emits `function_call` as structured event mid-stream. If we flatten it to v1, older clients expect a single final `function_call` chunk. We should buffer function-call events until we can determine completion or timeout (200ms). If timeout, emit a partial stub and mark `incomplete: true`.

alex: Good. Docs required: update migration guide with a compatibility matrix, known differences, and instructions on opting into compat-proxy (admins can toggle per key). Also add `curl` examples:```
# old client pattern
curl -H "X-API-KEY: $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
# compatible via proxy (same client continues to work)
# no change to customer code required when we route their key through compat proxy
```

maria: Logging: ensure we redact PII and prompt content from high-cardinality logs but keep hashed prompt id for regression tracing. keep sample payloads in S3 with opt-in.

sam: Rollout hazards: 1) long-tail customers with huge prompts could hit new kernel memory patterns; ensure proxy enforces max request size and returns 413 with helpful message. 2) Rate limit semantics might change: keep v1 quotas honored by mapping to v3 counters.

jyoti: For deprecation timeline, product requests: we say "v1 deprecated in 6 months, compat-proxy supported for 12 months after that." Need agreement.

alex: 6 months deprecation + 12 months compat window seems fair. But require active migration support for enterprise customers beyond that. Put this in the public deprecation post.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started: compat-proxy service version `v0.1.0-canary` -> 1% traffic (route: eu-west). :rocket:

maria: Quick ask — who owns the cost of running the proxy in Dedicated customers? For Private customers we should make compat-proxy optional; they can deploy it themselves or we supply a helm chart.

alex: Ops/team note: make proxy stateless and sidecar-friendly. We'll provide helm chart + k8s CRD for Private. For Dedicated, include as managed add-on (billing note).

sam: One more thing: test compatibility for streaming tokenization differences. We'll add a tokenizer normalization step in proxy that ensures token boundaries are preserved for older clients. This is lossy but necessary for a short window. Document clearly.

jyoti: Action items: 1) alex to create RFC PR with implementation checklist, 2) sam to prototype streaming translator, 3) maria to define SLAs and per-customer feature flags, 4) jyoti to add golden tests, 5) infra to prep staging route and S3 paths.

alex: I'll open RFC PR this afternoon (link will be posted here). Thanks all — let's keep messages concise in the PR comments. :thumbsup:
